restoration_note: The teaching describes the three works fixed at the consummation: the regenerated new earth that itself shines, the quenching of the fire of self-love, and the desolation of those who claimed what flowed through them — bound finally in the last bolos, fenced from the regenerated soul by a great boundary forever. The frame formulas are well-constrained: ⲙⲛⲧⲉⲩ...ⲙ̄ⲙⲉⲩ, ⲡⲉⲣⲁⲥ, ⲟⲩⲃⲉ, ⲙⲟⲩⲣ ⲍⲱⲱⲩ, ⲕⲁⲁⲩ, ⲟⲩⲱⲛⲉ ⲛⲧⲁⲱ, ⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ ⲙⲛ ⲡⲭⲁⲭⲉ, ⲥⲱⲧⲙ̄, and the doxological ⲱⲁ ⲁⲛⲏⲍⲉ̄ ⲛⲛⲁⲛⲏⲍⲉ̄. The damaged interior of work 1 and work 2 (gaps 5,6,7,9,10,11,12,16) is left unrestorable: not enough partial traces or formulaic context to fix the verbs and nouns there.

coptic_restorations.basis: Editor's standard 3pl idiom ⲙⲛⲧⲉⲩ X ⲙ̄ⲙⲉⲩ 'they have no X'; here completing ⲙ̄ⲙ[ⲉⲩ] at line edge.
Future-III prefix ⲉⲩⲁ- whose verb ⲙⲟⲩⲣ continues at the head of section 2372 ('they shall bind').
ⲧⲱⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧϩ ⲟⲩⲃⲉ 'stand fast against' is the standard contest formula; ⲟⲩⲃ[ⲉ] is fixed.
Greek loan πέρας 'end' — pairs explicitly with ⲁⲣⲭⲏ 'beginning' just preceding, and echoes ⲕⲉⲡⲉⲣⲁⲥ in 40.6.
Demonstrative/copular ⲡⲉ at line edge, opening the relative clause continuing into 2376 ⲧⲁⲩⲧⲁϣϥ̄.
Partial ⲛⲉⲥ + ~5 chars: not constrained enough to choose between possessive forms (ⲛⲉⲥⲍⲃⲏⲩⲉ etc.) or another stem; the entire mid-clause is too damaged to fix.
Partial ⲛⲟ + ~4 chars before next-section -ⲣⲁϩ: no formula or trace fixes the word.
~3 unread chars between ⲉⲧⲓ̈ⲙⲉⲩ and ⲕⲁⲧϩ; could be a verb or particle but no trace constrains it.
ⲁⲭⲱϥ 'upon him' (Lyc. for Sah. ⲁϫⲱϥ) parallels the earlier ⲁⲭⲙ̄ ⲡⲓⲕⲁⲍ in the same line and gives the right antecedent (the new land or First Man).
ⲥⲉⲛⲁ + ~5 chars opens the second work but no partial trace and no parallel formula constrains the verb (quench? destroy? overthrow?).
ⲛⲥⲉⲥ + ~4 chars: a paired verb to gap {9}; without the first verb fixed, no responsible reconstruction.
Single character at line break: any of several conjunctions or articles fits; no constraint.
~17 chars, only first letter ⲧ visible; far too long and weakly traced to restore.

ⲁⲩϣⲱⲣⲡ̄ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'they were torn/separated forth' — fits visible ⲁⲩϣⲱ + final ⲗ with editor's [ⲁⲃⲁ] restoration; matches reading's 'each set apart according to its bitter works.' Other ϣⲱ-stems (ϣⲱⲡⲉ, ϣⲱⲱⲧ) are possible.
ⲥⲉⲛⲁⲙ̄[ⲟⲩⲣ] ⲍⲱⲱⲩ — the standard reflexive 'they shall bind themselves' (ⲙⲟⲩⲣ + ⲍⲱⲱⲩ), confirmed by following ⲍⲱⲱⲩ ⲍⲛ̄ ⲧⲙ̄ⲣⲣⲉ ⲛ̄ⲍⲁⲏ.
ⲛ̄ⲥⲉ[ⲕⲁ]ⲁⲩ — Lyc. ⲕⲁ + 3pl pronominal ⲁⲩ = 'set/leave them'; the natural completion of the binding clause and matches the reading's 'sealed off forever.'
5 chars at end of comparison list ('as ember-pit, as gloom, as shadow ⲁⲧⲉⲓⲃⲉ ___'); could be another descriptive feminine noun pointing to ⲡⲱⲧⲉⲕⲟ in 2390, but unconstrained.

ⲛ̄[ⲟⲩⲱ]ⲛⲉ = ⲟⲩⲱⲛⲉ 'stone' (Lyc. for Sah. ⲱⲛⲉ); paired with ⲛⲧⲁⲱ 'boundary' in next segment yields 'boundary-stone' — exactly what the reading demands as the great fixed marker between regenerated soul and bolos.
ⲡ[ⲕⲉⲕ]ⲉ 'the Darkness' — required first member of the pair 'between the Darkness and the Enemy' (ⲁⲡⲭⲁⲭⲉ in 2392); standard lexicon entry.
ⲛⲟⲩ[ⲥ]ⲱⲧⲙ̄ — negative subjunctive of ⲥⲱⲧⲙ̄ 'hear'; pairs with ⲛⲉⲩⲍⲣⲁⲩ 'their voice' in 2393 ('that they may not hear one another's voice').
Standard doxological formula ⲱⲁ ⲁⲛⲏⲍⲉ̄ ⲛⲛⲁⲛⲏⲍⲉ̄ 'unto the eternity of the eternities.'
Completes ⲛ[ⲛⲁ]ⲛⲏⲍⲉ̄ in the standard 'forever and ever' formula.
